notes: Ported from tests/control-routing-commands.py and tests/control-vca-commands.py (the routing surface transcripts: a channel's graph, route_to / send_to / route_remove and what control.undo brings back). THE IDS ARE NOT SEQUENTIAL - measured: the master is ch-1, a new channel was ch-42 on one session and ch-36 on another - so every channel id here is BOUND from mixer.add_channel and every element is addressed by `[key=value]` (channels[id=@id:cha].sends), never by a guess. Measured refusals kept verbatim: pan on a mixer channel is refused in this build (`refused`), route_to requires a ch-<n> destination (`invalid_args`), a self-route is `invalid_args`, and `control.undo` of mixer.remove_channel is `irreversible` (class 'snapshot') - which is why the removal is the LAST thing this case does.
